reaction: The two panels clarify how electron flow is linked to ATP production.

mostWorthwhile.text: Remaking ATP was the most worthwhile construction: the planned two-panel illustration connects electron flow, hydrogen-ion pumping and ATP production, while retaining the cytosolic contribution.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen was relatively predictable, though its explanation was useful. The resulting short pathway does not explain the intermediate steps, so the connection from fuel breakdown to electron transfer remains compressed.

surprise.text: The distinction that fuel supplies energy while oxygen receives electrons and becomes part of water sharpened my understanding of their different roles.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each ingredient had a visible connection to the goal. The ion pump’s sodium and potassium binding sites were shown, though how they alternate was not explained.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: building from glucose breakdown to ATP production and then membrane transport made the connections between cell structures worth following. This is a judgment of the supplied text and illustration plans, not evidence of student comprehension.
